archetypes.name: dyn-design-wait-contracts
archetypes.rationale: Shared /design wait anchors replace hot-path prompt prose and need parity review.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed /design wait call sites and skills/shared/design-background-wait.md for contract parity. Verify each extracted rule preserves sentinel handling, premature-notification recovery, Step 3 table emission, and site-specific guards. Pay attention to whether the imperative load directives are close enough to the hot paths and whether any duplicated boilerplate remains. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
